description: Post-lowering AST conformance for the grids/duo duo-grid halo remap (Phase 2, duo_extend) at N=4: the whole-box clamped base fill plus the 24 per-tile seam regions, each a donor-cube-frame tent contraction over the padded donor field (0..N+1 sweep), with the staircase donor pinned per region. Exercises makearray region overwrite, literal-range + contracted aggregates, ifelse ghost extrapolation, and the closed-form donor maps. Numerically verified elsewhere (scratchpad) to reproduce the proven O(h^2) remap to machine precision; this case pins the canonical bytes.
